 Advertisement Updated: 6:19 AM CST Nov 4, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Brendan Weathers Meteorologist Quiet fall conditions return
 After last night's storms moved through, quiet weather is back! 16 WAPT Meteorologist Brendan Weathers has the details.
 Updated: 6:19 AM CST Nov 4, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Brendan Weathers Meteorologist JACKSON, Miss. — The cold front is moving through this morning. A few lingering rain showers remain in eastern parts of the state. Those clear out through the morning, with breaks in the clouds by midday. We start with temperatures in the 60s. Highs will reach the mid-70s by afternoon, with more sunshine through the afternoon and evening hours. Tonight’s lows fall into the low 50s.
 With this system clearing out, we go back to quiet weather for the next several days. Drier air moving in means pleasant fall conditions will settle back in. A secondary surge of cooler air by the end of the week will bring beautiful conditions through the weekend. A coastal system could increase cloud cover Sunday and into next week, but the details on that are still fuzzy.
